tokens.name: gg-orange
tokens.usage: Brand orange, exact from the logo (the "GG" and the upper swoosh). Identity fills, the logo, solar/PV highlights. Never as text on light grounds (2.6:1 on white); text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: gg-green
tokens.usage: Brand green, exact from the logo ("POWER", the tagline, the lower swoosh). Identity fills and marks; large text 24px+ only on `surface-raised` (3.6:1). For body-size green text use `primary`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: segmented-control track, slider track, code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card borders (not for controls).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary button, unchecked toggle); 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, units, metadata on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, selected state, links, and green text on surface / surface-raised / primary-soft. The accessible working shade of gg-green.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill for primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for selected cards and success notes; primary text reads on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Orange accent fill: solar/PV emphasis, marketing CTA. Text on it is on-accent (dark), never white.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange text on surface, surface-raised and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for PV / solar highlights; accent-text reads on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (solid 2px, 2px offset); 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success / online / charging status text and icons. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning status text and icons on surface, surface-raised and warning-soft. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fault / alarm / destructive status on surface, surface-raised and danger-soft. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational status on surface, surface-raised and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind info text.

tokens.name: energy-pv
tokens.usage: Chart series and icon for solar PV generation.

tokens.name: energy-battery
tokens.usage: Chart series and icon for battery (BESS) charge/discharge and SoC.

tokens.name: energy-grid
tokens.usage: Chart series and icon for grid import/export.

tokens.name: energy-load
tokens.usage: Chart series and icon for site load / consumption.
